environment_smoke: passed: correct fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed
coverage: 27319 output comparisons; exhaustive words of lengths 1-8; 64-bit boundaries and 64 pseudorandom words; 257-bit sequence; asynchronous reset, held reset, mid-conversion reset, and Moore stability between clock edges

tb_changes.reason: Initial restart released reset after a falling edge and send_bit waited for the next falling edge, allowing an unintended rising edge to sample x before the first intended bit. Failure at 36 ns followed this unintended sample.
tb_changes.correction: Release reset shortly after the held-reset positive edge, so send_bit drives the first intended bit at the following negative edge before the next sampling edge. All arithmetic expected values and stability checks remain unchanged.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Reset output is inferred as zero in the pre-first-one Moore state; original text does not separately specify reset z.
Original specification does not define power-up behavior before reset; testbench does not impose it.
No synthesis or board work performed.
